# vengtoo_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a role to a subject. Deleting this resource unassigns the role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Role to assign.
- `subject_id` (String) Subject ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: subject_id:role_id
